meta.summary:
I've created a comprehensive user flow diagram for buying sneakers online. The user journey was mapped out from the initial entry point through to checkout, covering key decision points and the typical e-commerce experience including browsing, product discovery, cart management, and authentication steps.

The flow shows two main discovery paths (search vs. browse), highlights important decision gates (size availability and login status), and captures the essential steps a customer would take when purchasing sneakers online.
